meta.notes: Rules for vanilla blocks (msm:vanilla_block_rules), as the additions add to vanilla content: an axe used on mossy cobblestone or mossy stone bricks scrapes them into the plain blocks (strip), a shovel used on mud with air above packs it (flatten), a hoe used on a moss block turns it into dirt and drops a moss carpet on top (till), and fire spreads to huge mushroom blocks and burns them away (burn, with the odds of msm:flammable). None of these pairs is vanilla's own, so nothing replaces a vanilla rule. Rules for vanilla blocks need the Fabric mod jar export.
